limitations: All five positive-weight source MAGIC_FREE records are included, preserving ordinary ATK12, DFS6/9/12 and the effect-only SUNDRY role.
MAGIC_FREE is an ordinary artifact extra, not a retained miracle. The five stable local indices do not change any earlier catalog or ability indices.
Only the first non-base MAGIC_FREE marks its immediate predecessor free in the source prescan. It does not search backward for the previous MAGIC or waive every magic in the command.
After a MAGIC has been used, a reached MAGIC_FREE card is consumed and gives a pending gift, then skips its own ATK, DFS and attribute processing.
Base47 alone remains a NE ATK12 weapon. MAGIC_FREE in base position does not waive a later miracle. SUNDRY239 has no standalone action kind.

The defense prescan also applies to MAGIC_FREE artifacts of every source type. A preceding210 or215 can consume or recast for free and break before reaching the suffix; the suffix then remains unconsumed.

The untouched suffix can enable retained defensive chains without an MP-based cap. Runtime response, gift and snapshot bounds must account for decision-limited chains rather than consuming the suffix early.
All records have NE attribute, MPcost0 and no percentage, disease, harm, boost or other special reaction. FREE membership preserves their extra effect.
